title: Openai Agents Sdk
motto: OpenAI Agents SDK is the lightweight multi-agent framework built on the Responses API. Five primitives: Agent, Handoff, Guardrail, Session, Tracing. Handoffs are tools named `transfer_to_<agent>`. Guardrails trip on input or output. Tracing is on by default.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: OpenAI Agents SDK is the lightweight multi-agent framework built on the Responses API. Five primitives: Agent, Handoff, Guardrail, Session, Tracing. Handoffs are tools named `transfer_to_<agent>`. Guardrails trip on input or output. Tracing is on by default.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Agents that cannot delegate cleanly end up stuffing everything into one prompt. Agents without guardrails ship PII, policy-violating output, or loop forever. OpenAI's SDK codifies the three primitives that make multi-agent work tractable.
